mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 6.0% for two consecutive months, it signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 6.0% for 2 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) signals a broad-based economic slowdown in consumer demand and manufacturing output, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and INDPRO decline, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening regimes (FEDFUNDS > 2.0% and CPIAUCSL > 3.0%), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns due to reduced corporate profitability and higher discount rates.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 2.0% and CPIAUCSL > 3.0%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer spending that supports corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when RSAFS is rising, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 95.0 for two consecutive months, it signals a manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate revenue growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 95.0 for 2 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in employment (PAYEMS) and decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals robust labor market conditions coupled with accommodative monetary policy, supporting equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
regime_hint: labor market strength with monetary easing
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS increases and FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle labor market conditions (UNRATE < 4.0% and PAYEMS growth > 0.5% monthly), the S&P 500 experiences negative returns due to overheating and policy tightening risks over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0% and PAYEMS growth > 0.5% monthly, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.
